title: Japan 10-year JGB auction (¥2,600bn anticipated) — opens issue 384, maturity 2036-09-20, the quarter's first 10-year print
source: EST: mof.go.jp English October 2026 auction calendar (english/policy/jgbs/auction/calendar/2610e.htm), re-fetched direct 2026-09-21 (HTTP 200, 24,852 bytes) — the row reads 'Oct. 6, 2026 | 10-year' with both the Auction Announcement and Auction Result cells the plain string 'Detail' and no href, so nothing about this auction has published yet. THE ISSUE IDENTITY IS DERIVED, NOT YET MOF-STATED: the September 2026 calendar (2609e.htm, re-fetched 2026-09-21) settles issue 383 on its Sep. 1 row ('10-year(383)'), and three MOF announcement pages fetched direct this session — auct20260625e.htm (07-02 auction), auct20260728e.htm (08-04) and auct20260825e.htm (09-01), all HTTP 200 — each read Maturity Date 'June 20, 2036' and Offering Amount 'About 2,600 billion yen', confirming issue 383 opened 2026-07-02 and ran two reopenings at an unchanged ¥2,600bn. The 10-year steps its issue +3 months and +1 number on every opening (established by the jgb-10y-auction-2026-11-05 ledger's 34-issue classification, 33/33 post-2018-03); three months on from a 2036-06-20 maturity is 2036-09-20, so 2026-10-06 is predicted to open issue 384 at that maturity, most likely at the same ¥2,600bn base case. NO SIZE IS ASSERTED BY MOF: none is announced, and this file asserts ¥2,600bn only as the pattern-implied anticipated base case. Filed `estimate` on the same two counts every sibling JGB entry records: this lane may not self-confirm an event it discovered in-sweep, and market-events-data.ts's confirmed-prefix taxonomy has no slot for a non-US sovereign debt office. The DATE is MOF's own and is not in doubt. Originally proposed 2026-09-10 by jgb-5y-auction-2026-10-14's initial research (src/domain/market-events/proposals/jgb-10y-auction-2026-10-06.from-jgb-5y-auction-2026-10-14.json); this file is this event's own initial research, written 2026-09-21.
notes: Terms for this auction publish on a measured 7-day lead (3 of 3 fetched this session: announcements 06-25→07-02, 07-28→08-04, 08-25→09-01 auctions), so the 2026-10-06 terms are expected 2026-09-29 — naming the maturity, offering amount and (per the sibling ledger's own reading of the announcement page) no coupon or issue number, both of which settle only at the calendar's post-auction update. This is the tenor's most BoJ-tapered maturity zone: the jgb-10y-auction-2026-11-05 ledger's dated finding (BoJ monthly operation workbooks, checked 2026-09-09) has the 'More than 5 years and up to 10 years' purchase bucket down -64.8% since 2024-01, the deepest cut of BoJ's six buckets, while MOF left 10-year issuance roughly flat over the same window — net supply to private hands at this tenor up +142.0%. The same ledger found the auction-quality mechanism this would predict (rising tail share) does NOT hold cross-sectionally: the two most-tapered buckets (5-10y, 10-25y) show no quality deterioration while the untapered 25y+ bucket shows the steepest rise, so no price channel is asserted from the taper alone. BoJ's Q4 purchase schedule (boj-jgb-purchase-schedule-q4-2026-09-30, due six calendar days before this auction) is the next primary that could revise the 5-10y allocation and is named as a watch item, not a trigger. NO PRICE CHANNEL IS CLAIMED and impact is low for the reason every sibling JGB entry records: no tracked symbol carries yen-rates exposure and no house playbook is rates-keyed. Estimate widens caution only; it licenses no date-keyed action.
